title.en: HR Already Climbing Hard at 0.7 km

tip.en: Heart rate hit 155 by 0.7 km on flat ground — 22 bpm above your recent average at this stage of a run. You went out considerably hotter than any of your last 8 sessions; check whether the perceived effort matched.
tip.zh: 仅0.7公里平路心率已达155，比近期同阶段均值高22次。你的出发配速明显快于近8次训练，建议回顾当时感知强度是否与数据一致。

title.zh: 第一次非计划停顿——约60秒路口等待

tip.en: Pace collapsed to near-zero for roughly a minute at 1.1 km; HR drifted down from 165 to 156 during the wait. When you resumed, you immediately surged to a 3:38 split — that snap-restart spikes cardiac load more than a continuous effort would.
tip.zh: 1.1公里处停顿约60秒，心率从165降至156。重新启动后立刻冲到3:38配速，这种急启对心脏负荷的冲击远高于匀速跑，建议停顿后用30秒缓入节奏。

tip.en: Your fastest split of the run landed right here, immediately after the red-light stop. The aggressive reacceleration is instinctive but burns a disproportionate match; a 15-second jog-out from the stop would recover the same time with a fraction of the cost.
tip.zh: 全程最快配速3:38出现在红灯后的立即重启。这种本能冲刺会过度消耗无氧储备；停顿后以15秒慢跑过渡，既能追回时间又能节省体力。

title.en: Second Stop: HR Refusing to Back Down
title.zh: 第二次停顿：心率拒绝回落

tip.en: Another standstill at 1.6 km, but unlike the first pause, HR barely budged — staying at 175–176 through the entire wait. That ceiling effect signals accumulated fatigue; your cardiovascular system had no room left to recover even at rest.
tip.zh: 1.6公里再次停顿，但与第一次不同，心率几乎纹丝不动，全程维持在175–176。这种'心率天花板'现象说明此时心血管储备已接近耗尽，即便静止也无法有效恢复。

title.en: 185 bpm on Flat Ground at 2.8 km

tip.en: Your all-run peak of 185 bpm arrived on essentially flat terrain (grade ~0–1%) around 2.8 km, not on a climb. Your recent 8-run max was 178 bpm; today's ceiling is 7 bpm higher, suggesting either accumulated thermal load, dehydration, or genuine overreaching — worth monitoring across the next two sessions.
tip.zh: 全程心率峰值185次出现在近乎平路的2.8公里处，而非坡道。近8次训练最高心率为178次，今日高出7次，可能源于热应激、脱水或累积疲劳，建议重点观察接下来两次训练的心率反应。

title.en: HR Finally Breaks Below 185 — Brief Respite
title.zh: 心率首次跌破185——短暂喘息

tip.en: From the 185 peak, HR steps back to 181 over the next 300 meters without any pace reduction — meaning the body self-regulated slightly. This is your physiological inflection point; the fact that you didn't blow up further suggests reasonable aerobic base, but the drift back up to 183 moments later shows the reserve is very thin.
tip.zh: 从185峰值开始，接下来300米心率在配速未降的情况下自然回落至181，说明身体进行了有限的自我调节。这是本次跑步的生理拐点，之后心率迅速回升至183，表明有氧储备已所剩无几。

title.en: Post-Run HR Drop: Slow Descent Worth Tracking
title.zh: 跑后心率下降：恢复速率值得关注

tip.en: At the end of moving time HR was still 162; it took roughly 40 seconds of standing still to drop below 140. For context, a well-recovered athlete typically sees a 30+ bpm drop in the first minute post-effort. Your slower decay here echoes the high avg HR throughout — log how you feel tomorrow morning before deciding on intensity for your next session.
tip.zh: 停止移动时心率仍为162次，约需40秒静止才能降至140以下。恢复良好的运动员通常在运动后第一分钟心率下降超过30次。今日较慢的恢复速率与全程偏高的心率一致，建议明晨起床时评估状态再决定下次训练强度。
